title: Order VII rule 11 — Rejection of plaint — CPC 1908

content.heading: Rejection of plaint
content.text: The plaint shall be rejected in the cases enacted in Order VII rule 11, including where it does not disclose a cause of action, where the relief claimed is undervalued and the plaintiff fails to correct the valuation within the time fixed, where the plaint is written upon paper insufficiently stamped and the plaintiff fails to supply the requisite stamp paper within the time fixed, where the suit appears from the statement in the plaint to be barred by any law, and the other enacted clauses. Read the official rule text.
